networks.name: agent_atlas
networks.description: Ask Atlas to find agentic websites by what they do, or to check a site before you link to it. Add your AI provider key in the settings to start.
sample_queries: Is there an agentic website that books boat tours? Is it safe to link to?
Check https://example.com/my_network against the spec and tell me what to fix.
Which sites in the directory are fully conformant?
Compare the two sites that sell food and tell me which one I could call from my own site.
Book me a table at a restaurant.
